layers.label: NISAR-observed water (candidate)
layers.note: HH < −18 dB on the latest NISAR pass ≤ 12 d old, outside permanent water; candidate (also lights flooded rice / irrigation).

layers.label: Flood risk with NISAR-observed water (candidate)
layers.note: Flood index (TPI) raised to Critical only where the latest NISAR radar pass up to 12 days before the map day saw open water (HH < −18 dB, outside permanent water) ON THE RIVER FLOODPLAIN (HAND ≤ 5 m): max(TPI, 0.8 × water on floodplain). NISAR water off the floodplain (mostly flooded rice paddies / reservoirs) is shown in the NISAR-water overlay but does not raise risk. Candidate water — never confirmed; no pass ≠ no risk.
